acceptance: make batch-member-check and make batch-land refuse when the primary clone has uncommitted or untracked changes under the member's frozen scope, naming the paths.
Unrelated primary-clone changes outside every member scope do not cause a refusal.
Tests cover the refusal and the unrelated-change case.

description: Member sessions edited files in the primary clone /Users/joe/Developer/BenchBox because relative tool paths resolve there. batch-member-check validates only the member worktree and agent-write-preflight guards only commits, so nothing caught it; a member noticed and the leaders moved the edits. A guard that compares the primary clone's uncommitted changes with the member's frozen scope catches the batch-relevant case without flagging unrelated owner work in the primary clone.
